mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 6.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, which typically precedes reduced corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity that precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% y/y, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market tightness (UNRATE < 5.0%), a rising unemployment rate signals unexpected job market deterioration that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises during labor market tightness, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
